name: Move
description: Move up to 2 spaces (orthogonal).

name: Copper Sword
description: Deal 3–5 damage to a target on an adjacent tile.

name: Focus
description: Draw 2 cards.

name: Spear
description: Deal 3–5 damage to a target on a cardinal tile 1–2 spaces away, then pierce through the tile behind it.

name: Knife
description: Deal 1–4 damage to a target on an adjacent tile, then draw a card.

name: Axe
description: Deal 4–8 damage to a target on an adjacent tile. Your next movement does nothing.

name: Quickstep
description: Draw a card, then move 1 space.

name: Tactical Approach
description: Draw a card and gain two Bonus Cards.

name: Bonus Card
description: Cannot be played. Discard for Move +1, Punch, or Scout — then this card is destroyed.

name: Parry
description: Defense is raised by 2 this turn.

name: Flurry of Blows
description: For the rest of this turn, each punch you throw hits twice.

name: Magic Missile
description: Deal 1–6 damage to a target on one tile in a straight or diagonal line from you. Ignores defense.

name: Card Seeker
description: Move 1 space. Drop 2 random cards as ground loot in rooms you can see.

name: Threefold Gift
description: Draw 3 cards.

name: Dash
description: Move up to 4 spaces (orthogonal).

name: Knockback Punch
description: Deal 3–4 damage to a target on an adjacent tile (counts as a punch). Knock survivors back 2 spaces, plus any primed knockback.

name: Bow
description: Deal 3–4 damage to a target on a tile within 8 spaces. Requires line of sight. Cannot target adjacent tiles.

name: Lightning Bolt
description: Hit a target on a tile within 5 spaces for 5 damage, then chain to new targets for 4, 3, 2, 1 damage. Ignores defense. Cannot hit the same tile twice.

name: Haste
description: For this turn, all player movement from every source is doubled. You cannot play Attack, Protection, Aid, or Deck cards for the rest of this turn.

name: Stealthy Advance
description: Move 1 space. -1 Noise. +1 defense this turn.

name: Fireball
description: Choose a square within 8 spaces (line of sight). Deal 4–6 damage in a 3×3 blast and inflict 1–2 Fire levels on everything hit.

name: Shield
description: Gain +5 defense for this turn.

name: Mace Smash
description: Deal 6–10 damage to an adjacent target. Ignores 1 defense. Add a Weariness card on top of your deck.

name: Weariness
description: Playing this card destroys it. Cannot be used for bonus actions.

name: Poisoned Blade
description: Deal 2–5 damage to an adjacent target. If it takes more than 1 damage, it gains 3 levels of Poison.

name: Loot and Scoot
description: Randomly spawn 0–2 coins in the dungeon. Move up to 2 spaces. If you land on a pot, gain 1 gold plus its loot.

name: Dual Wield
description: Play an Attack, then choose another physical melee Attack from your discard pile and play it immediately.

name: Flying Kick
description: Move 2 spaces in one direction. Targets in your path take 3–6 physical damage and 1 knockback. If the full move is blocked, nothing happens.

name: Great Sword
description: Choose an adjacent target for 7–12 damage, or a target 2 spaces away in a cardinal or diagonal line for 2–5 damage if nothing is between you.

name: Potion of Harming
description: Select a tile within 5 spaces. Creatures on it take 5 damage. That tile gains a harming cloud for 3 turns. Entering a harming cloud deals 5 damage.

name: Arcane Charge
description: You may only play Magic cards for the rest of this turn. Magic cards in your hand are upgraded for this turn.

name: Shining Blade
description: Deal 4–5 damage to everything on the tiles orthogonally adjacent to you.

name: Arcane Shield
description: Gain 7 Resistance this turn. Resistance absorbs incoming damage (ignoring defense) until depleted.

name: Magic Missile+
description: Deal 5–6 damage to a target on one tile in a straight or diagonal line from you. Ignores defense.

name: Fireball+
description: Choose a square within 8 spaces (line of sight). Deal 5–7 damage in a 3×3 blast and inflict 5 Fire levels on everything hit.

name: Lightning Bolt+
description: Hit a target on a tile within 8 spaces for 8 damage, then chain to new targets for 7, 6, 5… damage. Ignores defense. Cannot hit the same tile twice.

name: Arcane Charge+
description: You may only play Magic cards for the rest of this turn. Magic cards in your hand are upgraded for this turn. Draw a card.

name: Shining Blade+
description: Deal 6 damage to everything on the tiles orthogonally and diagonally adjacent to you.

name: Arcane Shield+
description: Gain 10 Resistance this turn. Resistance absorbs incoming damage (ignoring defense) until depleted.

name: Perfected Strike
description: Discard any number of Attack cards from your hand. If you discard at least one, attack an adjacent target dealing 5 damage plus 5 more for each card discarded.

name: Fortify
description: For this turn your defense and resistance is doubled.

name: Stay on the Move
description: Choose a Move card from your discard pile which is immediately played.

name: Heal
description: Heal 10% of your max health. Cannot be played if you have played any cards this turn, and you may not play any cards after this.

name: Evaluate
description: Draw a card. Discard any number of cards and draw one for each discarded.

name: Reckless Assault
description: Deal 3–6 damage to an adjacent target. Before dealing damage, choose to lose any amount of health. For every health you lose, the attack gains 2 damage.

name: Thieving Strike
description: Deal 1–4 damage to an adjacent target. 25% chance of gaining one gold, or 100% if you kill the target with this attack. +1 gold if the target is hit with knockback this turn.
